def test_state_roundtrip(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "RALPH_DIR", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "STATE_FILE", tmp_path / "state.json")
    state = ralph.default_state("verify tests work")
    state["feedback"] = "RALPH_INCOMPLETE: decode missing"
    state["verified_since_replan"] = 3
    state["pending_freebuff_verification"] = ["- [ ] write tokenizer — implement bpe merges"]
    ralph.save_state(state)
    assert ralph.load_state() == state


def test_load_state_rejects_garbage(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "STATE_FILE", tmp_path / "state.json")
    assert ralph.load_state() is None
    (tmp_path / "state.json").write_text(json.dumps({"feedback": 7, "pending": "x"}))
    assert ralph.load_state() is None


def test_record_freebuff_completion_appends(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "RALPH_DIR", tmp_path)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ralph, "STATE_FILE", tmp_path / "state.json")
    ralph.save_state(ralph.default_state("verify tests work"))
    ralph.record_freebuff_completion("- [ ] add tests — cover round trip")
    loaded = ralph.load_state()
    assert loaded is not None
    assert loaded["pending_freebuff_verification"] == ["- [ ] add tests — cover round trip"]


def test_replan_prompt_contains_goal_and_contract() -> None:
    prompt = ralph.build_replan_prompt("verify tests work")
    assert "verify tests work" in prompt
    assert "ralph/tasks.md" in prompt
    assert "Do not\nimplement".replace("\n", " ") in prompt or "Do not implement" in prompt
